snippet.title: DING DONG DEAD - Babysitting Slasher
snippet.description:
Get it: http://patreon.com/puppetcombo

The ultimate in BABYSITTING TERROR. All your choices matter as you navigate a night of horror and debauchery while trying to survive the 'Ding Dong Ditcher Ripper', a recently escaped serial killer from the nearby state asylum.

Created by Jordan King
